scope: Scatter constraint IDs into exclusive per-body adjacency ranges
tolerance_reason: Counts, IDs, scratch and untouched words are integer-exact. Atomic ID ordering is validated as exact per-body multisets.
preconditions: Valid active contact body IDs and finite inverse mass; zero-length gaps may contain stale body IDs
Counts reset for counting/building or exact exclusive row starts for scatter
Enough ID/scratch storage and no u32 count overflow; ordered kernels share persistent buffers
invariants: Empty manifolds and manifolds touching multibodies are filtered before adjacency insertion
Whole-vector inverse mass controls graph membership, including partially locked bodies
Every active dynamic side contributes exactly one ID, preserving self-contact multiplicity
Copied inputs, guard words and inactive storage remain unchanged
